name: Crucifixion
overview: The crucifixion, as revealed in Scripture, is both a historical event and a profound spiritual reality. Jesus Christ was crucified alongside two criminals, fulfilling prophecy and bearing the curse of the law to redeem us (Matthew 27:38; Galatians 3:13). Believers are called to identify with Christ in this death to sin, as Paul explains that our old self is crucified with Him so that we no longer serve sin, and that Christ lives in us by faith (Romans 6:6; Galatians 2:20). The cross remains a central offense and reproach, symbolizing the suffering endured by Jesus and His followers (Matthew 23:34; Galatians 5:11).
